title: Salt Solution Mixture Tank Problem
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: A 100-liter tank initially contains pure water. Brine containing 0.5 kg of salt per liter enters at 2 L/min, and the well-stirred mixture leaves at 2 L/min. Find the amount of salt y(t) in the tank at time t.

steps.title: Solve via Integrating Factor
steps.mathExpression: \mu(t) = e^{t/50} \implies \frac{d}{dt}[e^{t/50} y] = e^{t/50} \implies e^{t/50} y = 50e^{t/50} + C \implies y(t) = 50 + C e^{-t/50}

steps.title: Apply Initial Condition y(0) = 0
steps.explanation: Initially pure water has 0 kg salt.
